title: The run's merge keeps dropping the person's 37i block on u9h and dispatching attempts the block exists to stop (seventh counterexample)
body: The person blocked u9h on tick 37i at 1b725f49 (origin/main, still HEAD). The run's merge 96977e99 dropped 37i from u9h.blocked_by on the run branch, and this dispatch (attempt 28) was launched against that block-less copy despite attempts 22 through 27 all reporting blocked on the same cause. Each counterexample spends a go6 intervention that the block exists to conserve. Already drafted five times (keys a2d01075, 221dfd7e, 86596dbe, 9aca70a0, bf0109fd); this report deduplicates rather than re-proposing, but the underlying merge defect remains untriaged and unfixed.
